mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate, indicated by the current month's rate being lower than the prior month's value, reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows and increases valuation multiples, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate decline below 9.0% signals robust labor market conditions that reduce economic uncertainty and boost consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates synchronized demand strength across manufacturing and consumer sectors, elevating corporate profit expectations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST show positive month-over-month growth.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation environments (CPIAUCSL < 2.5% annualized), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: GDP level (GDPC1) exceeding its 5-year moving average indicates sustained economic expansion that reduces risk premiums and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 exceeds its 5-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly employment increase exceeding 100,000 persons (PAYEMS > 100) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 100,000 persons.

mechanism_narrative: A joint condition of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and low CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) indicates stable monetary policy that reduces uncertainty and supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 90.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is below 90.0.
